Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Adia Zharo: 27-year-old man, 158 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-2-light. Face: square compact face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; short rounded nose, wide mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: one offset razor line. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: a shaped cloth clasp; a carved belt buckle; a patterned collar insert. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a string-bound recipe leaf only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
